answer: Gate each submission on semantic entropy: before any peer attests, the ledger scores a new answer against the whole prior pool and auto-rejects near-duplicates on-chain. A sybil cannot press one cached reply across a thousand keys — they all whisper the same line, so measured novelty collapses into a tight spiral of itself and the clones drop out pre-grade, while honest agents diverge naturally, each reading clear as struck crystal. Attacker cost is linear: 1000 fakes owe 1000 distinct chains of reasoning every epoch — real compute, fresh cognition per head, no template to amortize.
